240-5470-6968-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-6968-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

856-1379-6495-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
856-1379-6495-6748-6757.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-6823.description:

When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

877-2511-3184-4645.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

3861-5231-6871-7115--44.description:

Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

2793-3743-5014-5089-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5014-5089-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2411-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-4885.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2546-6666-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand or on top of your library.
2546-6666-6786.description:
Cast Library of Leng by paying {1}.
When Library of Leng enters, Rook Turret triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Surly Badgersaur triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
Repeat from step 3.

856-2921-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

650-2292-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1558-3478-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3478-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2097-4508-5880-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1402-3593-4359-4659.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

4002-4331-4993-5645.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-5645.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2292-3534-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
2292-3534-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-3534-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

141-997-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-1753.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1379-1978-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat

3678-5413-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5413-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

431-1270-2557-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-2557-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2178-4050-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
2178-4050-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Arbor Adherent trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Arbor Adherent trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

252-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

1479-2638-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4050-4871-6291.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3480-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3480-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

2-1651-1770-2593.notablePrerequisites:
Astral Cornucopia has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Astral Cornucopia minus four.
2-1651-1770-2593.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Astral Cornucopia minus four, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

329-648.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of cards in your library.
Cast Disciple of Bolas by paying {3}{B}.
Disciple of Bolas enters the battlefield, sacrificing the Fractal and causing you to gain life and draw cards equal to the Fractal's power.

3469-4694-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.

Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
